bug_semantics: Admin UsersController#profile is excluded from the validate_role before_action (except: profile, profile_edit) so that any authenticated user can open their own profile. The action also honors an optional query parameter user_id: when present it loads current_site.the_user(user_id.to_i).object and renders that record's profile (email, username, role, custom fields) via edit. There is no compensating ownership or :manage, :users check, so any authenticated low-privilege user can GET /admin/profile?user_id=<sequential integer> and disclose arbitrary users, including administrators (CWE-862 IDOR).
flaw_origin: The except: [:profile, :profile_edit] skip existed from the 2015-07-09 Version 1.0 controller, but profile then always assigned @user = current_user (later current_user.object), so the skip was a self-service exemption, not an IDOR. The IDOR mechanism was first written on 2015-10-17 in 3415939272499a06c64d6ae8f641e4a9cfca43ba ('comments module rebuilt'), which changed profile to @user = params[:user_id].present? ? current_site.the_user(params[:user_id].to_i).object : current_user.object while leaving profile excluded from validate_role and adding no ownership check. Later commits only renamed current_user to cama_current_user and split the line for RuboCop; they did not introduce the lookup.

reasoning: CVE-2026-56720 / GHSA-x628-p4h4-vf39 is a real, published missing-authorization IDOR on CamaleonCMS Admin::UsersController#profile: authenticated callers may pass an enumerable user_id query parameter and read another user's admin profile because profile is excluded from validate_role and, until the 2026 patch, performed no ownership check. The except skip is older than the bug and was originally a correct self-profile exemption (Version 1.0 profile always loaded current_user). The smallest commit that first wrote the vulnerable mechanism is 3415939272499a06c64d6ae8f641e4a9cfca43ba, which introduced current_site.the_user(params[:user_id].to_i).object on profile while keeping the except list. Immediate parent 083fa8a7170f96f83fa8cfbe391957f579f220db still assigns @user = current_user.object, so the IDOR lines are absent there; the commit is a single-parent first-write, not a move/revert/merge squash with reconstructable members.
